source.additional_inner_ear_caveat: The bundled Z-Anatomy README separately lists an adapted University of Dundee School of Medicine inner-ear source under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. Assets containing selected ear geometry are held for licence review.
source.additional_cranial_nerve_attribution: The bundled Z-Anatomy README lists Cranial Nerves and Foramina by University of Dundee, CAHID under CC BY 4.0 among referenced/included/adapted models; retain that attribution pending per-object provenance review.

prohibited_combinations.reason: The review assembly duplicates all nine independently loadable cranial-nerve groups.

warnings: This release-safe manifest contains 16 non-held cranial packages. The two inner-ear-containing build packages are intentionally omitted.
middle_inner_ear_bilateral_v3 and cranial_support_registered_assembly_v3 remain HOLD_FOR_INNER_EAR_LICENSE_REVIEW and their binaries are not in the publishing tree.
Generic atlas-derived anatomy; not patient-specific and not a clinical segmentation.
Color differentiates teaching layers only and encodes no physiology, deficit, function, or pathology.
Do not use for diagnosis, treatment planning, navigation, procedural rehearsal, device sizing, or clinical decisions.
The source atlas is not exhaustive; absent anatomy is never inferred or procedurally invented.
Anatomical identity, laterality, continuity, spatial registration, terminology and patient-facing use require specialist review.
Derivatives retain Z-Anatomy/BodyParts3D attribution and ShareAlike obligations.
Retain the bundled University of Dundee CAHID CC BY 4.0 cranial-nerve attribution pending per-object provenance review.
